Harmonic balance gives A²*((omega0²+3*alpha*A²/4-omega²)²+gamma²*omega²)=F0². In the usual bistable averaged regime the middle branch is a saddle and the outer branches are stable.

evidence.title: NIST DLMF28.2 and28.17, Mathieu normalization and stability
evidence.finding: Canonical Mathieu coefficients are dimensionless after rescaling time; converting a dimensional stiffness-modulation parameter requires the corresponding frequency-squared factors.

Other damping normalizations change numerical factors, not the units. Hold no rewritten equation as a substitute for the source.
